name: GratisAPI
tagline: A completely free, 100% static, open-data API.
description: GratisAPI is a collection of static JSON APIs hosted on GitHub Pages. Every endpoint is a plain JSON file: no keys, no rate limits, no tracking, no cost. Gratis means free.

apis.title: Articles
apis.description: Guides, explainers and essays about free data, the APIs and the philosophy behind GratisAPI.
